caseName: Olmstead v. L. C. ex rel. Zimring

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 1054.] The order entered December 14, 1998, granting the petition for writ of certiorari is amended to read as follows: “Certiorari granted limited to Question 1 presented by the petition.”
